name: Petal and Posy
description: A flower seller's barrow, crowded with pots and buckets, every stem kept fresh by a charm she renews at dawn.

name: The Sweet Tooth
description: A baker's van under a striped awning. You can smell it from the gate.

name: Quill and Binding
description: A stationer and second-hand bookseller who knows what students can afford.

name: The Tinker's Tray
description: A folding table of small things, useful and otherwise, and a card reader held together with tape.

name: Second Circuit
description: Refurbished phones, old consoles and boxes of parts, sold by a woman who can tell you what is wrong with yours by listening to it.

name: Seven Petals
description: The convenience store on every corner in the country, open twenty-four hours: snacks, chargers, contraception, pregnancy tests, lottery cards and cheap charms, under very bright lights.

name: Petal & Pill
description: The pharmacy chain: general medicine on one side, Bloom and pregnancy on the other, and a pharmacist who has stopped being surprised by anything.

name: Byte & Bloom
description: Phones, PCs, components and repairs. The staff will tell you, unasked, that it is not their fault if you enchanted it yourself.

name: Arcana
description: The magical supply shop next door to Byte & Bloom: wands, crystals, spell components and small enchantments. A man can buy here; he just can't use most of it.

name: The Forbidden Shelf
description: The occult bookshop beside the Book Nook: magical theory, grimoires in facsimile, histories nobody set as reading, and a locked case of questionable artefacts.

name: Second Bloom
description: The thrift shop, named for what it gives old clothes and for what women past fifty call the years after the Bloom lets go. Run by three of them.

name: The Spell & Sip counter
description: Coffee and pastries to take away, rung up by whoever is nearest the till.
